articles.title: Indian, Chinese business leaders discuss deeper economic cooperation in Shanghai
articles.description: Indian and Chinese business leaders met in Shanghai to boost economic ties. Discussions focused on trade, investment, and technology. Both sides expressed interest in concrete collaborations to align with India's growth and global integration.

articles.title: InclusiveAI: Public voting model could open AI decisions to broader communities
articles.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems affect many parts of daily life, including health care, education, and public policy, but the public has had few meaningful opportunities to participate in the development, governance, or modifications of AI systems, according to Tanusree Sharma, assistant professor in the Penn State College of Information Sciences and Technology. As a result, AI systems may not align with the needs of diverse communities.

articles.title: Starbucks to cut 61 technology jobs in Seattle
articles.description: Starbucks is making headlines with the announcement of 61 tech job reductions at its Seattle HQ, signaling a pivotal phase in the company’s transformation journey. These layoffs align with an overarching strategy to sharpen focus on elevating customer experiences and driving revenue growth. This decision comes after prior restructuring efforts, including the closure of some locations.

articles.title: Turnaround Tata Stock? Tejas Networks is readying to ride the AI infrastructure wave
articles.description:
After a phase of BSNL-led scale-up, this Tata Group stock is entering a quieter but far more critical phase. With large project-driven revenues now behind it and significant investments already made, the next leg of growth will depend less on building technology and more on converting opportunities into revenue.
For investors, the story is no longer about how much the company can develop or deploy, but how effectively it can translate its pipeline into earnings, improve working capital and align its cost structure with actual demand.
